newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Keppel Marine wins US$60 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Keppel Marine wins US$60 mln contract.

text.p: Keppel Marine Industries, part of the Keppel Corp group, said on Thursday it had won a major shipbuilding contract worth about US$60 million to build two vessels.
Keppel said the contract was to build 18,300 BHP anchor handling tug/supply vessels and the value of each exceeds US$30 million.
The contract, awarded by the Dutch A.P. Moller Group (Maersk) also includes an option to build two more units.
Keppel said it would provide engineering design in addition to building the vessels.
The first vessel is expected to be completed in second half of 1998 and the second is expected to be delivered in the first quarter of 1999.
Shares of Keppel Marine ended unchanged, at Singapore $1.56 on Thursday.
